verdict.rationale: Glama documents hosting for your own code: it builds an image from a connected GitHub repo or from a Dockerfile, npm package or PyPI module, and puts its Gateway in front of the resulting endpoint with "no manual wiring". That covers the hosted half of the story. Nothing shows OpenAPI-to-MCP conversion, or that non-MCP custom code is wrapped without implementing the protocol yourself. missing for 10: OpenAPI/API-definition-to-MCP generation, evidence that custom code needs no MCP protocol implementation, independent hands-on corroboration of the hosting flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing

citations.quote: Connect a GitHub repository and Glama builds the image straight from source.
Ship a Dockerfile, an npm package, or a PyPI module. Configure Node or Python versions, build steps, and CMD arguments – or let Glama infer them.
No proxy setup, no manual wiring – the endpoint you get is the Gateway.
